_README: GG input for the 2026-10-27 batch. Guidance STANDING after the 2026-07-29 releases, transcribed from the cited SEC accessions (retrieved 2026-07-30). basis/comparison default to COMPANY_GUIDANCE / OWN_PRIOR_GUIDANCE; polarity is derived from `metric` (see pre_guidance.POLARITY). Names absent from this file get GG=None DECLARED, never 0.

FTNT.quote: For the fiscal year 2026, Fortinet currently expects: Revenue in the range of $8.020 billion to $8.180 billion
FTNT.prior_quote: For the fiscal year 2026, Fortinet currently expects: Revenue in the range of $7.710 billion to $7.870 billion

FTNT.quote: Diluted non-GAAP net income per share in the range of $3.41 to $3.47
FTNT.prior_quote: Diluted non-GAAP net income per share in the range of $3.10 to $3.16

FTNT.quote: Billings in the range of $9.350 billion to $9.550 billion
FTNT.prior_quote: Billings in the range of $8.800 billion to $9.100 billion

HOOD.quote: we are lowering and tightening our 2026 outlook for Adjusted Operating Expenses and SBC to a range of $2.675 to $2.775 billion to reflect efficiencies we have captured
HOOD.prior_quote: Our prior outlook for 2026 Adjusted Operating Expenses and SBC provided at Q1 2026 Earnings (April 28, 2026) was $2.7 billion to $2.825 billion

META.quote: We are raising the lower-end of our expense outlook to incorporate the $2.4 billion charges related to legal proceedings recognized in the second quarter. We now expect full year 2026 total expenses to be in the range of $165-169 billion.
META.prior_quote: We expect full year 2026 total expenses to be in the range of $162-169 billion, unchanged from our prior outlook.

META.quote: we expect our tax rate for the remaining quarters of 2026 to be between 15-17%, an increase from our prior outlook of 13-16%
META.prior_quote: we expect our tax rate for the remaining quarters of 2026 to be between 13-16%

META.quote: We anticipate 2026 capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, to be in the range of $130-145 billion, narrowed from our prior outlook of $125-145 billion
META.prior_quote: We anticipate 2026 capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, to be in the range of $125-145 billion
